title: Zoom in the loop builder
summary: Zoom and pan across the canvas in the Loops loop builder, so large, complex automations stay readable as you build and edit them.
body_markdown:
You can now zoom in the loop builder. This release includes viewport zoom and pan updates, touch gestures and Cmd/Ctrl + wheel zoom. These updates make it easier to move through large loop diagrams without losing your place.


Pan across a dense canvas, zoom into one section to edit it, then reset the view and keep working on the full flow.


Learn more in the[Loop Builder docs](https://loops.so/docs/workflows) .
